title: How big is that?

milestone.title: Binary: The Language of the Machine

description:
Convert a number of bytes into readable sizes, both ways people count.

```
Bytes: 1500000
1.50 MB  (1000-based)
1.43 MiB (1024-based)
```
hints: Keep dividing by 1000 while the value is at least 1000 and there is a bigger unit left (lesson 2.03).
Write one function `readable(size, base, units)` and call it twice.
requirements: Units: B, KB, MB, GB, TB (powers of 1000) and B, KiB, MiB, GiB, TiB (powers of 1024).
Pick the largest unit where the value is at least 1, and print two decimals.
stretch: Explain in a comment why a "1 TB" drive shows as about 931 GiB.
